name: Graphify — Knowledge Graph Skill That Cuts Session Tokens 49×
hook: 68.4k stars. Graphify turns any folder of code, SQL schemas, docs, research papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph — Tree-sitter static analysis (40+ languages) combined with LLM-driven semantic extraction. The Claude Code integration is one command: it installs a CLAUDE.md directive and a PreToolUse hook so Claude consults the graph before every file-search tool call, cutting tokens per session by up to 49×. Multiple benchmarks show 70× fewer tokens vs raw codebase ingestion. Featured by @charlieautomates this week as the foundational 'always-on knowledge graph' layer to pair with Claude Code sessions. MIT.

name: last30days-skill — Multi-Platform Research Across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN + 9 More Sources
hook: 44.3k stars, v3.3.0 (MIT). The top trending Claude Code skill on GitHub: type `/last30days [topic]` and Claude simultaneously queries Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, HN, Polymarket, GitHub, and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary ranked by real upvotes and engagement — not editorial selection. The v3 engine identifies relevant handles, subreddits, and hashtags before searching, then cross-clusters findings across sources. Zero config for Reddit/HN/web; X, YouTube, TikTok, and Perplexity unlock with optional API keys in 30 seconds. 1,012 tests. Works across 50+ agent harnesses via the SKILL.md standard.

name: Loop Engineering — The Paradigm Shift Claude Code Builders Are Rallying Around
hook: This week Peter Steinberger's two sentences hit 6.5 million views on X: 'You shouldn't be prompting coding agents anymore. You should be designing loops that prompt your agents.' Claude Code lead Boris Cherny echoed it: 'I don't prompt Claude anymore — loops prompt Claude.' Addy Osmani published the definitive essay. Chase AI posted 'The NEW Way to Use Claude Code in 2026 (Loops)' on June 15. The movement's concrete tools: `/loop` (recurring scheduled prompts, added March 2026) and `/goal` (run until a condition holds, v2.1.139), plus git worktrees for parallelism and n8n MCP for external automation. 2,200+ posts on X this week.

name: n8n-mcp — Build Real n8n Automations from Claude Code via MCP (v2.59.0, June 18)
hook: 21.8k stars, v2.59.0 released today (June 18). The n8n-mcp server gives Claude Code encyclopedic knowledge of n8n's 1,845 workflow automation nodes — properties, operations, real-world examples — so Claude can design and deploy working n8n automations directly from a conversation, not just describe them. The companion n8n-skills repo adds 7 SKILL.md files covering expression syntax, workflow patterns, validation, and MCP-tools expertise. Named by @charlieautomates as the recommended autonomous-loop backend in the June 15 '24/7 Agents' tutorial and by @Chase-H-AI in the Loops video. MIT.

name: Unreal Engine 5.8 Built-In MCP Server — Claude Code Drives the Unreal Editor
hook: Unreal Engine 5.8, announced June 17 at Unreal Fest Chicago, ships an experimental built-in MCP server that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any other MCP-compatible agent drive the Unreal Editor over a local HTTP connection — spawning actors, configuring lighting, creating material instances, editing Blueprints, and running automation tests from a terminal. First major game engine with first-party MCP support. Enable via Edit > Plugins > Unreal MCP (Toolset Registry auto-included). Experimental: APIs are subject to change. Community complement ibrews/ue5-mcp extends it with pixel streaming and Python editor scripting as a Claude Code skill.
install: Enable 'Unreal MCP' plugin in Edit > Plugins (Unreal Engine 5.8+)

name: Claude Code v2.1.181 — /config Syntax, CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE, Bun 1.4
hook: Released June 17 with 20+ changes. Three new quality-of-life additions: (1) `/config key=value` sets any Claude Code setting without leaving the prompt — e.g., `/config thinking=false`, `/config model=claude-opus-4-8`; (2) `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` env var suppresses mobile push notifications when you're at the machine; (3) `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` opt-in for sandboxed macOS commands that need it. The bundled Bun runtime upgrades to 1.4, auto-retry fires on API connection drops mid-thinking (no more lost reasoning chains), and the subagent panel gets auto-hide, scroll hints, and better organization. Notable fix: Write/Edit no longer produces truncated files on network drives and cloud-synced folders.

name: Opus 4.8 Build Day Hackathon Winners — Tekton, Custom Universe, Sim Francisco
hook: Anthropic published winners from the June 13 Opus 4.8 Build Day (300 builders, 12 hours, $500 credits each — 1,500 applicants). Three standouts: Tekton — Holly Tang & Austin Burgess 3D-reconstructed Tang Dynasty architecture from phone scans using Apple RealityKit + Claude-operated remote NVIDIA H100; Custom Universe — Jake Stevens (Luminal, Rochester CV grad) & Mauricio Pereira (Coat Robotics, MIT robotics grad) built a synthetic training-data generator for robotics using only open-source models; Sim Francisco — election outcome forecasting with synthetic AI personas. The Tekton project is the clearest signal of where Opus 4.8 + Claude Code is pushing: design + computer vision pipelines built end-to-end without a human in the loop.

name: Claude Platform Workload Identity Federation GA — No More Static API Keys
hook: Workload Identity Federation (WIF) became generally available on the Claude Platform on June 17. Instead of a shared static API key, each workload authenticates with the identity it already has — an AWS IAM role, GCP or Kubernetes service account, Azure managed identity, GitHub Actions token, or any other OIDC-compliant provider — and the Platform issues a short-lived scoped access token. Every API call is logged against a named service account with its own roles and audit trail. Covers all Claude API endpoints including Claude Code and the Agent SDK. Particularly useful for teams trying to scope Claude Code's automation footprint per environment.

name: CCPM — GitHub Issues + Git Worktrees for Parallel Agent Execution
hook: 8.2k stars. CCPM (Claude Code Project Manager) gives multi-agent development a traceable backbone: ideas become PRDs, PRDs become epics, epics become GitHub Issues, and each issue gets its own git worktree so agents can execute in parallel without conflicts. GitHub Issues are the single source of truth — no hidden agent state. Deterministic bash scripts (zero LLM cost) handle `/standup` and `/status` reporting. The core rule: 'Every line of code must trace back to a specification.' Automaze says it cut their internal shipping time roughly in half after months of internal use. Ships with CLAUDE.md; works with Claude Code, Factory, Cursor, and any Agent Skills–compatible harness.
